chapter_seo_title: Li Huowang Forms an Unholy Alliance with the Void Nian Against the Dragon Vein
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang teams up with his former enemy, the Void Nian, against the unstoppable Dragon Vein. A brutal fight with time-bending consequences.
og_title: The Year Beast Strikes – A Desperate Alliance in the Dao-Twisted World
og_description: When the Dragon Vein proves immune to everything, Li Huowang must trust the monster that tried to kill him. The Void Nian’s secret power changes the battlefield.
twitter_title: When your only ally is the beast that tried to eat you
twitter_description: Li Huowang and the Void Nian vs. the screaming tower of dead emperors. This chapter is pure pain and teamwork.

lore_anchors.definition: In Chinese geomancy, the underground energy channel that determines a dynasty's fate. In this novel, it is literalized as a writhing tower of stacked emperors.
A corrupted Nian beast with a woman's face on a lion body; it drains yang life on contact and can accelerate time in a localized field of red afterimages.
The metaphysical lifespan energy that supernatural entities feed on; the Dragon Vein's emperors are too ancient to have any yang life left for the Nian to drain.
Li Huowang's indestructible, summoned companion; she acts as his shield but is starting to falter under the Dragon Vein's repeated attacks.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why can't Li Huowang hurt the Dragon Vein with any of his abilities?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Dragon Vein is a fundamental part of the world's ruling structure—it's protected by a different class of metaphysical rules than ordinary monsters or cultivators, making it immune to the specific powers Li Huowang has collected so far.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What does the Void Nian's red afterimage field actually do?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It accelerates time locally, causing rapid healing and decay cycles on anything caught inside it. This makes the ancient emperors of the Dragon Vein de-age and destabilize, threatening to break the Vein apart.
